name: Numabuchi Ryuuzou
source:
The delinquant leader in 1996 and 1999, seems to want some bad things to [url=https://vndb.org/c10020]Tsukumo[/url].
His war symbol is a dragon.

[spoiler]He is the older brother of [url=https://vndb.org/c10017]Torazou[/url], He died in a motorcycle accident 3 years before the "present time".

It is for this reason that Torazou understands Tsukumo's sorrow when his sister dies and seeks to help him.[/spoiler]
